resume: DZ edition of Golana, an analog-style synth (two oscillators, five filters, arpeggiator) with a 64-step sequencer, 32 programs, a song mode (SONGMODE) and USB MIDI out added.

commandes.role: Lowers the keyboard octave. Held alone at power-on, starts USB rescue mode.
Opens the effects pages: MOD FX, DELAY, REVERB. A new press moves to the next page.
Opens the filter pages: FILTER, KEY TRACK. A new press moves to the next. Printed SCL in the repository docs.
Opens the envelopes: FILTER EG, AMP EG.
Opens AMP, VOICE, GLOBAL (tempo, tuning, clock, MIDI IN) and SETUP (effects order, palette, home screen drawing).
Opens PERFORM: cutoff, resonance, EG intensity, LFO 1 rate. On the write screen, cancels.
Opens program writing: PRESETS chooses the slot, KNOB 1 the letter, KNOB 2 changes it, SAVE writes, HOME cancels. Not possible during playback.
Turns the arpeggiator on or off.
Opens the arpeggiator pages: ARP, TIMING, STEPS, then SONGMODE. A new press moves to the next.
Opens the sequencer pages: PATTERN (step, note, type, accent or slide) and SETUP (length, resolution, duration, swing).
Moves through the pages one after another.
Changes program (32). It loads as you turn: unwritten changes are lost.
Sets the cutoff, from any page.
Play the synth. On the PATTERN page, a key writes its note into the step and moves to the next.

gestes: OCT- held at power-on: USB rescue mode, with no sound or interface, to reinstall a firmware.
The four rotary knobs (KNOB 1 to 4) set the four cards shown on the screen.

modes.texte: REC, PATTERN page: STEP chooses the step (1 to 64), NOTE its note, TYPE REST, NOTE or TIE, ACC / SLIDE its accent or slide. SETUP page: LENGTH from 1 to 64. The screen shows the steps in groups of 16. PLAY starts. One note per step.

SEQ, SONGMODE page: SONGMODE (OFF or ON), FIRST PROG and LAST PROG (programs 1 to 32), PLAY MODE (ONCE plays once to the last, REPEAT loops back). The song chains consecutive programs, from FIRST to LAST.
The firmware sends its notes as MIDI over USB to drive other synths. The settings detail is not described in the docs.

a_savoir: Experimental edition, use at your own risk.
Steps 17 to 64 are kept apart from the program save. If all the device's project slots are taken, SONGMODE shows PROJECTS FULL and the write is refused.
It is not a full MIDI file player.
